text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT P1 — embeddings-eu high tail latency (>500ms). paging pager-duty and oncall team. link: https://status.redwood.example/incidents/INC-8912

Alex G: saw the alerts spike around 10:23 UTC, routing backlog up and p99 token timeouts. users in EU experiencing search/semantic match slowdowns.

Maya S: joining. any visible deploys?

Jamal R: no deploys that match the window in k8s events. I pulled relay logs, seeing a lot of KV cache misses and redis timeouts to redis-eu-1.

Lina T: redis-eu-1 showing increased connections + swap? host mem at 92%. possible noisy job?

Alex G: quick mitigation — switching routing to dedicated eu-secondary cluster to reduce load. executing oncall runbook section "embeddings-fallback" now.

devx-ryan: command ready if you want me to flip the route: `curl -X POST https://controlplane/api/v1/route/shift -d '{"from":"embeddings-eu","to":"embeddings-eu-secondary"}'`

Alex G: do it.

incident-bot: ACTION — route change initiated by devx-ryan at 10:29 UTC.

Maya S: monitoring. p50 drops from 120ms to 85ms, p95 from 420ms to 160ms. still some errors but trending down.

Jamal R: created ticket INC-8912 in ops-triage: "Redis saturation causing embeddings latency in EU" — assigned to Lina.

Lina T: flagged an internal GC job in infra that spikes at 10:20 UTC daily. suspect job colliding with peak. scheduling a patch to stagger jobs. will file infra ticket.

Alex G: primary/secondary for night shift — I’ll be handing primary to Maya and Jamal will be secondary for the next 12h. Lina will be backup on infra. @pager-duty confirm coverage handoff.

pager-duty: handoff confirmed. Maya S primary (12:45 -> 00:45 UTC), Jamal R secondary, Lina T infra backup.

Maya S: noted. leaving binder with mitigations and runbook pointers: https://docs.redwood.example/runbooks/embeddings#fallback-routing and https://docs.redwood.example/runbooks/redis-saturation

Alex G: quick logs snippet from the relay showing retries and backoff:
```
2026-03-14T10:25:12Z relay[pid=1234] WARN kv_cache_miss key=embedding:123 attempt=3
2026-03-14T10:25:12Z relay[pid=1234] ERROR redis-eu-1 timeout after 3000ms
```

Maya S: action list before full handoff:
- ensure route to eu-secondary is persisted until infra patch (Maya)
- Lina to file INFRA-4457 to stagger GC jobs and attach perf traces (Lina)
- Jamal to add KV cache metrics dashboards and set alert (Jamal)
- Alex to draft post-incident note and coordinate retro (Alex)

Jamal R: created dashboard ticket DASH-202 and set temp alert with lower thresholds.

Lina T: filed INFRA-4457: "stagger redis GC + tune vm swappiness". ETA for patch: 48h. link: https://tickets.redwood.example/INFRA-4457

Alex G: filing follow-up ops postmortem doc and scheduling a 30m retro — tentative: 2026-03-16 14:00 UTC. I'll add agenda: timeline, root cause hypothesis, mitigations, rollout to prod, alert tuning.

Maya S: I picked up the temporary monitoring playbook items. leaving note in the thread before I go offline in an hour.

devx-ryan: reminder — for next time we can enable prefix caching for embeddings on the edge to reduce calls to redis during bursts. added to OPT-345 backlog.

Alex G: P1 closed as service recovered and errors returned to baseline at 10:47 UTC. Keeping tickets open for follow-ups. Closing notes: customer impact limited to increased latency for EU embeddings calls for ~25m window, no data loss.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE — status: recovered, impacted customers: partial EU region, duration: 00:24:00, follow-ups: INC-8912, INFRA-4457, DASH-202.

Maya S: handing over primary to oncoming shift (ping @pager-duty when they take over). leaving contact: +1-555-0101 if urgent. :wave:

Jamal R: secondary handoff complete. I'll pick up monitoring for the next 12h and follow up on DASH-202.

Alex G: action items recap (from thread):
- Alex: write postmortem doc + share with eng and infra by EOD 2026-03-15
- Lina: implement INFRA-4457 + attach perf traces
- Jamal: complete DASH-202 and set durable alerts
- Maya: maintain route until INFRA-4457 deployed, update status page if needed
- devx-ryan: PR for prefix cachingOPT-345

Maya S: thanks all. anything else before I drop?

Lina T: nothing from infra side, thanks.

Alex G: good handoff. I'll ping when postmortem is up. :thumbsup:
